citations.assessment: Rabbah bar bar Chana sees the Ninevite wear a cork sandal on a public fast and asks about Yom Kippur. The immediately preceding report is by Yitzchak bar Nachmani about Yehoshua ben Levi and reverses the occasion.
The reported occasion is the public fast, distinct from the preceding report on Yom Kippur.
